thread:
ryan: Quick postmortem follow-up from today's vendor auth outage — collecting owners, timelines, and checks for recurring patterns. Root cause: regional auth provider flakiness -> registry timeouts -> some services didn't short-circuit to cached manifests.

ryan: Proposed action items (assign/confirm):
1) Auth multi-region fallback + client short-circuit on token refresh failures (owner: elena) — target 2026-04-12
2) Model-registry read-path resilience: local cache + blobstore fallback + retry/backoff tuning (owner: samir) — target 2026-04-05
3) Recurring-incident detector and trend dashboard (owner: katie) — target 2026-04-20
4) Runbook updates: explicit circuit-break steps and degrade-to-local-model checklist (owner: jordan) — target 2026-03-30
5) Vendor contract/SLA review + escalation playbook (owner: ryan) — target 2026-04-15

elena: I'll take #1. Plan: implement region failover for auth calls and client-side short-circuit after 4 consecutive 5xxs. Opening PR today and will tag @ryan and @ops-bot.

samir: Taking #2. Design: 5m TTL cache for registry reads, `stale_while_revalidate=30m`, and blobstore fallback for older manifests. Drafting design doc — need infra help for cross-region namespace mirror.

katie: I'll own #3. Detector rule idea: alert when `sum(auth_errors{job=\"auth\"}) / sum(auth_calls{job=\"auth\"}) > 0.05` over 3m AND `model_registry_5xx / registry_calls > 0.02` correlated. Start as non-pager, escalate to SRE if repeated. Adding weekly trend query for vendor spikes.

jordan: On the runbook I'll add steps: check vendor status page, flip registry to cached manifests, enable circuit breaker, and route traffic to alternate region. Also adding a weekly staged fallback test to release checklist.

ryan: Created JIRA tickets: RW-ENG-1245 (#1), RW-ENG-1246 (#2), RW-ENG-1247 (#3), RW-ENG-1248 (#4). Paste PR/JIRA links here when you have them.

samir: Quick question: do we want to document eventual consistency for cached manifests? I propose `cache_ttl=5m` and `stale_while_revalidate=30m`. Will add note in design doc. @elena — any token expiry UX concerns?

elena: TTL fine. We'll add a degraded-response header `X-Model-State: degraded-cache` so clients can decide.

katie: For trend detection I'll add a 90-day rolling check to flag vendors showing repeated auth spikes, and a monthly digest to product/security.

ryan: ops-bot, attach incident logs to the JIRA tickets and link this thread please.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0472 created and attached to RW-ENG-1245..1248. Logs uploaded: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0472.zip

jordan: Also adding a CI smoke test that simulates auth 500s + registry 503s to validate fallbacks. I'll add it to the release gating tests.

samir: Need a 1h sync with infra for blobstore perms/mirroring. @elena can you join?

elena: Yep — morning PST works. Ping me for a calendar invite.

ryan: Owners please confirm acceptance by EOD. If blocked or need more time, call it out here. I'll run weekly check-ins until all JIRAs are green. :eyes: :thumbsup:

elena: confirmed. PR incoming. :thumbsup:

samir: confirmed, scheduling infra sync.

katie: confirmed — detector RFC in my backlog, will post by Friday.

jordan: confirmed, updating runbook now.

ryan: Thanks everyone. I'll add a recurring agenda item to next SRE sync to watch for vendor patterns and churn. Closing thread once all JIRA statuses are resolved.
